cases.prompt: Start a 300 x 200 ft factory called North Plant and leave it as an unsaved draft.
cases.notes: Source units normalize to meters; dimensions remain user intent rather than final coordinates.

cases.prompt: Build a new plant with dimensions 100 by 80 m; do not add departments yet.
cases.notes: The envelope is independent of later department work.

cases.prompt: Make a 120000 x 80000 mm facility and keep the southwest floor corner as the origin.
cases.notes: Millimeter input exercises deterministic unit normalization.

cases.prompt: Set up a factory floor 4800 x 3600 in named Pilot Annex.
cases.notes: Inch input exercises the fourth supported source unit.

cases.prompt: Divide the facility into seven departments named Intake, Cutting, Welding, Paint, Assembly, Test, and Shipping.
cases.notes: Labels-only requests use equal-area partitioning with a disclosed assumption.

cases.prompt: Partition the floor into four equal departments in two rows: Receiving, Fabrication, Build, and Dispatch.
cases.notes: The partition solver owns geometry for the requested rows.

cases.prompt: Create six departments in columns with area shares of 10%, 20%, 15%, 25%, 20%, and 10%.
cases.notes: Explicit valid proportions override equal-area defaults.

cases.prompt: Arrange five departments from west to east and keep each requested label exactly as written.
cases.notes: Orientation is semantic input; the solver computes polygons.

cases.prompt: Rename the current department called Final Check to Customer Acceptance without moving it.
cases.notes: A label-only edit preserves stable geometry.

cases.prompt: Resize the existing Assembly department and reflow only its affected neighboring zones.
cases.notes: Dependency-aware reflow must preserve unaffected departments.

cases.prompt: Add one department beside the current Packaging zone while preserving every locked department.
cases.notes: A scoped addition cannot silently unlock existing entities.

cases.prompt: Remove the existing quarantine department only if nothing still references it.
cases.notes: Reference validation determines whether removal can proceed.

cases.prompt: Use 55%, 35%, and 25% for the three departments.
cases.notes: Conflicting percentages require clarification rather than normalization.

cases.prompt: Create four departments, but the labels include duplicate labels that I have not resolved.
cases.notes: Stable labels cannot be guessed.

cases.prompt: Persist the reviewed cumulative facility diff now.
cases.notes: Save remains a separate explicit command.

cases.prompt: Build a 200 by 120 m facility first, then we will decide the department program.
cases.notes: The first eligible stage is the envelope even when later intent is deferred.

cases.prompt: Create a two-way forklift aisle between Receiving and Assembly using the approved route width.
cases.notes: Circulation follows macro departments and requires width evidence.

cases.prompt: Place the selected machine in Machining after checking its exact revision and fit.
cases.notes: Asset placement remains revision-bound and deterministic.

cases.prompt: Arrange the selected workcells with a feasible U strategy and preserve locked members.
cases.notes: The strategy is a preference until deterministic feasibility accepts it.

cases.prompt: Add requested floor markings for the pedestrian crossing after the route is validated.
cases.notes: Floor communication follows valid route geometry and explicit intent.
